name: Default
shortDescription: Engram Cloud server: shared, project-scoped memory sync for AI coding agents with a browser dashboard, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in at /dashboard/login with the ENGRAM_CLOUD_ADMIN value from the environment, then open /dashboard/bootstrap to create the first managed admin. Engram CLI clients sync with the ENGRAM_CLOUD_TOKEN value: run engram cloud config --server https://<your-domain> on each machine.
ENGRAM_CLOUD_ALLOWED_PROJECTS defaults to * (every project). Replace it with a comma-separated list of project names to restrict what the shared sync token can reach.
